response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), total AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members FROM grouped) SELECT g.major_id, g.member_count, CAST(g.member_count AS REAL) / t.total_members AS fraction FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Members with no major are those where link_to_major IS NULL. Empty-string values, if any exist, are not excluded.
The denominator is the sum of member counts over the major groups shown (members with a non-null major), not the total row count of the member table.
The fraction is computed as a REAL division with no rounding, and ties are not broken by a secondary key.
